captions_note: the card replaces the picture and carries the words: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions only while they are up (work/reel_captions.json)
in_a_reel: start the slot on a word or a cut and end it on a cut or a new sentence: the card cuts in and out hard

the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style (font, weight, tracking, case, ink, accent) before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: edit TITLE and NODES in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints each node and its time, the snapshot times and the caption window
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
